sources.title: Reproducible builds: definition and scope
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: GitHub Actions：工作權限與不可信輸入隔離
related.titleEn: GitHub Actions: job permissions and untrusted-input boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩次建置清單、10個摘要、差異分類及環境重建說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two build manifests, ten digests, classified differences and environment reconstruction instructions.
related.difference: 把事件來源、程式信任程度、token權限與密鑰可見性畫成矩陣，分開測試與發布工作。
related.differenceEn: Map event source, code trust, token permissions and secret visibility; separate test jobs from release jobs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 一致率=摘要相同的指定產物/全部指定產物；功能測試通過與位元一致是兩種證據。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 兩次本機建置各產10個合成產物，7個摘要相同，3個含不同生成時間。 初始一致率7/10=70%。
最小權限縮減率=(原授權動作數−必要動作數)/原授權動作數；動作數僅是教學代理量。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 三個測試工作各被授8種動作，實際各需2種唯讀動作；發布工作另行評估。 測試工作授權由24降6，縮減18/24=75%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Reproducibility rate counts matching specified artifacts; functional correctness and byte equality are different evidence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two local builds each produce ten synthetic artifacts; seven match and three embed different generation times. Initial reproducibility rate=7/10=70%.

Permission reduction=(original actions−required actions)/original actions; action count is only a teaching proxy. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Three test jobs each receive eight action permissions but need only two read-only actions; assess release separately. Test-job grants shrink from twenty-four to six, a 75% reduction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Falco：容器行為例外與訊號保留
related.titleEn: Falco: container behavior exceptions without losing signals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩次建置清單、10個摘要、差異分類及環境重建說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two build manifests, ten digests, classified differences and environment reconstruction instructions.
related.difference: 記錄規則、巨集、事件來源及必要欄位，將合法維護與應調查事件分別標籤。
related.differenceEn: Record rules, macros, event source and required fields; label authorized maintenance separately from events requiring investigation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 一致率=摘要相同的指定產物/全部指定產物；功能測試通過與位元一致是兩種證據。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 兩次本機建置各產10個合成產物，7個摘要相同，3個含不同生成時間。 初始一致率7/10=70%。
降噪率=(原誤報−新誤報)/原誤報；需同時檢查真陽性是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件產生24筆警示，其中8筆應調查、16筆為已核准維護；窄例外可排除12筆維護。 誤報由16降4，降噪率75%；若8筆應調查全保留，precision由8/24升至8/12。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Reproducibility rate counts matching specified artifacts; functional correctness and byte equality are different evidence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two local builds each produce ten synthetic artifacts; seven match and three embed different generation times. Initial reproducibility rate=7/10=70%.

Noise reduction=(old false positives−new false positives)/old false positives, alongside true-positive retention. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic events yield twenty-four alerts: eight investigable and sixteen approved maintenance; a narrow exception removes twelve maintenance alerts. False positives fall from sixteen to four, a 75% reduction; retaining all eight true positives raises precision from 8/24 to 8/12.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
